requirements.title: The demo-vault ingestion shall produce one raw entry in the public vault's raw directory for each source link in the author-provided deep-research Markdown file

vision.paraphrase: Demo-vault research ingestion populates the public vault from ~40 ingested research sources on AI adoption in medium-sized enterprises.

The demo vault is populated via a one-time research-ingestion epic: the author supplies a deep-research Markdown file with ~40 source links and the ingestion pass creates raw entries and interlinked wiki pages.

conops.paraphrase: When the ingestion pass begins with an author-provided deep-research file containing 40 source links, one raw entry is created per source.

requirements.title: The demo-vault ingestion shall produce interlinked wiki pages carrying title, tags, status, and description frontmatter with Related and Referenced By wikilink sections

vision.paraphrase: The Karpathy-pattern ingestion process creates interlinked wiki pages with all required frontmatter and wikilink sections.
From raw entries, interlinked wiki pages are authored with frontmatter-driven metadata and Related/Referenced By sections.

conops.paraphrase: After raw entries are created, the ingestion process authors interlinked wiki pages with title, tags, status, description frontmatter and Related/Referenced By wikilinks.

requirements.title: The public vault shall build into a graph whose node and edge counts demonstrate demo-scale density rather than the placeholder vault's near-empty board

vision.paraphrase: The deployed public vault is built from ~40 ingested research sources, fanning out to a few hundred wiki pages and connections, replacing the 2-page placeholder.
Demo-vault ingestion replaces the 2-page placeholder vault with a demo-scale dataset.

conops.paraphrase: When the populated public vault is built, graph-data.json contains at least 40 nodes and 60 edges, demonstrating demo-scale density.

requirements.title: The public vault shall contain only original research content, with no confidential organizational, family, or health material from the private second-brain vault

vision.paraphrase: Safe-by-construction boundary ensures private vault content never reaches the deployed page.
The seed/demo public vault content is original research on AI adoption, never confidential org data.

conops.paraphrase: When every page is reviewed prior to commit, only content from the deep-research file or the author's synthesis exists in the public vault.

requirements.title: The repository's full git history shall be audited and confirmed free of private content before the repository's visibility is changed to public

vision.paraphrase: Repo goes public after a history audit confirms no private content, a critical precondition for transparency.

conops.paraphrase: Before the repository visibility is flipped to public, the full git history across all commits and branches is audited and confirmed free of private, organizational, or family/health content.

requirements.title: The repository shall be publicly readable by an anonymous, unauthenticated client once its history audit has passed

vision.paraphrase: Source transparency works when the repository is public so GitHub source links resolve for anonymous visitors.

conops.paraphrase: When a visitor clicks the GitHub source link, the raw .md file resolves in the public repository without authentication.

requirements.title: The deployed /graph page's stats footer shall render its full provenance clause, reporting a source count equal to the number of sources ingested into the public vault

vision.paraphrase: The meta.sourceCount field supplies the deployed footer's 'built from K sources' claim, closing the loop from ingestion to display.

conops.paraphrase: Closes the loop from ingestion through the build to the deployed footer, and asserts the deployed page must never fall back to the no-provenance rendering — that fallback appearing in production would signal the ingestion or build silently broke.
